problems.text: Balance the acidic reaction Cu(s) + HNO₃(aq) → Cu²⁺(aq) + NO(g) by the half-reaction method. Give the electrons in each half-reaction, the electrons transferred overall, and the coefficients of the balanced equation.
problems.constants: Appendix L (OpenStax); F = 96,485 C/mol; 0.0592 V at 25 °C; molar masses from the OpenStax periodic table. Amounts: SCENARIO_CLAUDE.

expected.label: coefficients of the balanced equation
expected.unit: Cu(s) + 2 HNO₃(aq) + 6 H⁺(aq) → 3 Cu²⁺(aq) + 2 NO(g) + 4 H₂O(l)
